hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s)||{};const i=j.tool_input||{};const r=j.tool_response||{};process.stdout.write(String(i.path||i.file_path||r.filePath||""))}catch(e){}})'); if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"eslint hook: no file path in tool payload (checked tool_input.path, tool_input.file_path, tool_response.filePath); nothing to lint"}'; exit 0; fi; case "$f" in *.js) if npx --no-install eslint --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"eslint hook: eslint unavailable - run npm install; skipped this edit"}'; exit 0; fi;; *) exit 0;; esac
